title: Chris Ballard on Daniel Jones: I probably underestimated his accuracy

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chris Ballard on Daniel Jones: I probably underestimated his accuracy
sources.description: Quarterback Daniel Jones performed well in his first season with the Colts before suffering a torn Achilles late in December — so well that the club rewarded him with a two-year, $88 million deal despite the injury.
